newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Meredith FY97 EPS view up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Meredith FY97 EPS view up.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co Inc analyst Rita Zanella Benson said Friday she increased her earnings per share estimate on Meredith Corp for FY97 ending June 30 to $2.37 from $2.25. The most recent First Call consensus mean estimate was $2.35 a share.
--Benson also said she raised her FY98 estimate to $2.75 a share from $2.69. In addition, she increased the price target on the media company's stock to $60 from $50.
--The Gruntal analyst said she revised her estimates after meeting with Meredith management.
